Branch cursor/u22-realtime-round-stats-0727 — U22 shipped, do not look on master.

RealtimeRoundStats folds a FightRealtime impact log into RoundScoring.round_points counters. Adapter only: sums logged wear, does not re-derive damage from force. Lands are clean/glancing/absorbed (absorbed connects and costs 0.25). Grappling keys emitted as zeros. Composition check feeds fold() straight into round_points.

LIM-U22-NO-TECHNIQUE: head_foot and body_foot are not producible from this log (no technique field; region-only map). Digest at research/U22_DIGEST.md. Did not touch HANDOFF.md.
